notes.t: Capacity: 150 guests
Mid-season (April, October) rental €7,250 per night
Peak season (May to September) rental €8,500 per night
Rates include VAT; cleaning fee €1,750 + IVA; 40% deposit, rest 6 weeks before
52 overnight guests standard, up to 78 for an extra charge, 150 event guests
No sound restrictions
Must use one of 5 recommended exclusive caterers; food trucks cannot replace the wedding meal
2027 open dates offered in March, April and late October to early December; many more in 2028
Under 30 minutes from Barcelona airport, a few minutes by car from Sitges
Coordinator not mandatory but strongly advised for big weddings
Website check: Site: events up to 250 and 'We can seat 150 guests'; the email's cap of 150 is for seated dining (250 dancing only). Consistent; record max 150 = seated, 250 = standing/dancing.
Website check: Site lodging: '52 overnight persons as a standard, up to 78'; home page also says 'expand to 76' once. Email says 78.
Website check: Coordinates left null: OpenStreetMap has no point for the estate, only the town centre.
